title: Commission sends Statement of Objections over proposed joint venture between UPM and Sappi
summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 26 Aug 2026 The European Commission has informed UPM-Kymmene Corporation ('UPM') and Sappi Limited ('Sappi') of its preliminary view that its proposed joint venture may restrict competition in the markets for different types of communication paper, which is used for printed materials, such as magazines or books.
